item.title: Two senior aides to HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to depart amid leadership shakeup
item.description: Two senior leaders at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services are expected to step down as part of a broader restructuring within the agency.Deputy Secretary Jim O’Neill and General Counsel Mike Stuart are preparing to leave their roles, according to sources familiar with the changes. item.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is reporting more than 910 measles cases nationwide in 2026, as local health officials confirm a new outbreak in Western Riverside County.According to Riverside University Health System, an adult and a child have tested positive for measles in western Riverside County. item.title: What Is Galentine’s Day? How the Friendship-Focused Holiday Became a Valentine’s Tradition
item.description: For many people, Valentine’s Day comes with expectations — romantic dinners, gifts and grand gestures. But an increasingly popular alternative is giving people a chance to celebrate something just as meaningful: friendship.Galentine’s Day, celebrated February 13, began as a fictional holiday on the sitcom Parks and Recreation. item.description: A suspect is now in custody following a double homicide in Thermal.According to the Riverside County Sheriff's Office Central Homicide Unit, 43-year-old Alberto Tomas Padron of Mecca has been identified as the suspect.Deputies responded just before 11:30 p.m. Wednesday to a home on Polk Street in Thermal, where they found two men suffering from gunshot wounds. item.title: TODEC Donation Drive Supports Immigrant Families in Coachella
item.description: TODEC Legal Center hosted a donation drive today at its Coachella offices to support immigrant families facing ongoing challenges.Donations were accepted from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., with community members dropping off nonperishable food, hygiene products, and new household goods to help families dealing with safety concerns and financial hardship.TODEC leaders say the need has grown significantly this year, with more than 3,000 families each month seeking assistance.
